2021.title: Evo Online

2022.title: First time in Las Vegas

2023.title: The biggest bracket

2026.title: New titles, same goal
2026.body: Evo France 2026 in Fatal Fury, Marvel Tōkon and Avatar Legends.

evo.title: The world's most important fighting game tournament.
evo.lead: The Evolution Championship Series (Evo) is the Fighting Game Community's main meeting point: an open tournament where anyone can register and face the world's best in the same bracket.
why: It's an open tournament: results are earned match by match, not by invitation.
It brings together the world's elite and thousands of players on the same weekend.
It's the showcase where publishers announce news and the community meets.
Competing repeatedly shows commitment, level and the ability to travel and produce content on site.
evo.audienceBody: Evo's figures describe the event, not our community. We use them to give context to the competition, not to promise reach. Any audience metrics of our own will be shared with real data.
evo.disclaimer: We are not Evo organisers and have no official relationship with the Evolution Championship Series.

bios.kazukun: Competitive fighting game player from Barcelona. He has competed at Evo Las Vegas and Evo France in titles such as Street Fighter V, Street Fighter 6, Ultra Street Fighter IV, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, Marvel Tōkon and Avatar Legends.
bios.blueken: Competitive fighting game player since 2018. He has played Evo Online, Evo Las Vegas, Evo France, HFSPlay, Fighting Holidays and Barcelona locals, with standout results in Melty Blood: Type Lumina, Hunter × Hunter Nen × Impact and Fatal Fury.

partnersPage.promiseTitle: What we promise (and what we don't)
promise: Competitive results verifiable on public sources.
Content produced as agreed and delivered on time.
Reports with real data after every activation.
We don't promise views, followers or conversions without data to back them.

faq.q: Are you an official Evo team?
faq.a: No. We're independent players who register and compete at Evo events. We have no official relationship with the Evolution Championship Series.

faq.q: Can you wear our logo on your apparel?
faq.a: Yes, as long as the event rules allow it. We define it in each proposal.
Every partnership is quoted individually based on events, deliverables and duration.
We'll share real metrics from our channels in the proposal. We never mix Evo's audience with ours.

setup.title: Pending configuration (development only)
setup.body: Add these variables to .env.local (or Vercel → Environment Variables) and restart/redeploy:

criterion.label: Bracket level with or behind
criterion.short: {pct}% of the bracket level with or behind
criterion.title: How we read results
criterion.note: Bar = (entrants − placement) ÷ entrants, calculated per tournament from start.gg data. start.gg publishes tied placements (e.g. 25th = tied 25th–32nd), so we say "level with or behind" rather than players beaten. "Top X%" = placement ÷ entrants. We never add up entrants from different tournaments.
